PACE vs B0 trajectories diverge; cannot attribute the same child to alternate parents.
Zero new LLM calls; not a causal proof of SPaCE online gains.

go_nogo.rationale: Mixed signals: document false-retention pressure and forced-eviction dominance, but do not claim soft-selection will fix online Δacc without a new frozen protocol. Default course delivery = freeze PACE v1; SPaCE only as labeled extension if pursued.
go_nogo.delivery_stance: PACE v1 (15-seed cap-align) remains the course primary deliverable regardless. SPaCE is a conditional research extension, not a replacement of frozen results.
